violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child
violation_type.typical_finding: A school age child's file did not have current school information listed on the enrollment form.

finding_variants.text: A school age child's file did not have current school information listed on the enrollment form.
Two out of ten children record read didn't have school information.   Note: The director obtains this information and placed it on the admission forms during the inspection.
A child's Elementary School information (Address and Telephone number) was not documented on the Admissions Form.     This was corrected when brought to the Director's attention.
1 school-age student file was evaluated and did not contain information regarding the pubic school the child attends on their enrollment form.
Three out of 10 children's records I evaluated did not have school information.

One of the ten children files was missing school-age information.    One of the ten children files was missing food allergy information.    Five of the ten children files were missing special care statements.
